# OAJI - Open Academic Journals Index

> OAJI is a comprehensive open-access academic journal index and discovery platform providing searchable access to peer-reviewed journals and research articles globally.

OAJI (Open Academic Journals Index) is operated by Cherkas Global University and serves as a central hub for discovering, indexing, and accessing open-access academic journals across multiple disciplines. The platform enables researchers to find quality publications while providing publishers with tools to register and manage their journals.

## Core Discovery & Search

- [Home](https://oaji.net): OAJI homepage - Open Academic Journals Index with journal search and discovery
- [Library OAJI](https://oaji.net/library-oaji.html): OAJI library - searchable database of open-access academic journals and articles
- [Journals List](https://oaji.net/journals-list.html): Complete directory of indexed journals in OAJI with peer-reviewed publications
- [Our Journals](https://oaji.net/our_journals.html): Registry of journals indexed in OAJI with global coverage and statistics

## Journal Analytics & Rankings

- [Statistics](https://oaji.net/statistics.html): OAJI journal metrics, publication data, and visitor analytics dashboard
- [TOP 50 Most Downloaded Articles](https://oaji.net/journal-rate.html): Ranking of top downloaded articles by download metrics and popularity

## Publisher Tools & Registration

- [For publishers - Authorization](https://oaji.net/for_publishers.html): Publisher portal login and authorization for journal account management
- [Apply for Evaluation / Free Service](https://oaji.net/apply-for-evaluation-free-service.html): Journal registration and free evaluation service for indexing in OAJI
- [OAJI Logo](https://oaji.net/oaji-logo.html): OAJI branding resources and logo downloads for journal publishers

## About & Support

- [About Us](https://oaji.net/about-us.html): About OAJI - mission, history, and organization overview by Cherkas Global University
- [Contact Us](https://oaji.net/contact-us.html): Contact information and support details for OAJI organization

## Legal & Policies

- [Terms and Conditions](https://oaji.net/terms-and-conditions.html): Legal terms, CGIJ scoring criteria, and journal indexing requirements
- [Privacy Policy](https://oaji.net/privacy-policy.html): Privacy policy and data protection terms for OAJI platform users
